speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the onset of your gait and limb ataxia, and do you have any history of alcohol use or neurological conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is the ataxia progressive or did it start suddenly, and do you have any history of cancer or recent infections? I also need to know if you experience any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your limbs.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and recent natalizumab use, I am highly concerned about Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). REQUEST TEST: Brain MRI with contrast

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain shows lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML); T1/T2 images show multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement.
